reason: Mostly holds, with timing and rule fixes. Today (28 Sep) has exactly one slot left: probes 47, 48, 49 and 50 already went. Amendment A fills that slot with a CI file in both branches, and CI files may only go before 29 Sep 02:00Z. Under R0/R-/R?, exp83c (SEC + CI) needs a Q3 yes and CI acceptance before it can be a final. exp75 (#37 + CI) needs only CI acceptance, so it dominates exp83c for finals value. Moving exp75 to today also brings its read forward from ~09:30Z 29 Sep to ~22:00Z today. The build is sound: exp75 differs from exp79a only in cell 0 (DIVINS_CAP 4 vs 6). Its kernel is COMPLETE. Its dummy has #37's topology and exp79a's coordinates. Its hidden latency is bounded by exp79a's measured 9.27-9.45 h, well under 12 h. Flaws: (1) Probe 50 was submitted 05:02:30Z and was still PENDING at 10:33:21Z. With L <= 7.67 h it turns terminal ~12:25-12:50Z, so the branch is unknown at 12:00Z. The swap must fire at 50's terminal header (latest 14:00Z). (2) exp75 is on the R21-A3 (e) NO-GO list (28 Sep 00:00Z, 'superseded, not unsafe'). Its 2,288 s dummy (ratio 1.49) is in the rule-v2 re-run band; it is exempt only because it was logged 27 Sep, before rule v2. Both points need an explicit pre-score line. (3) The finding sends exp83c to the night slot it frees, so that slot again goes to a file with no finals value while Q3 is open. (4) exp75's own finals value is modest, not dominant. Its display is not an independent CI read, and the pair {exp79a, exp75} puts CI in both finals (the CI lab had a -0.021 clip; PC25-06). It still beats exp83c's ~0.
fix: Before 56629533's terminal header, log one pre-score line: 'W2b amendment A2. At 50's terminal header (not 12:00Z; latest 14:00Z): R0/R-/R? -> exp75, replacing exp83c. R+ -> exp87a as in amendment A, and exp75 at 00:06Z 29 Sep. exp75 is lifted from the R21-A3 (e) NO-GO list for this slot. Its 27 Sep dummy (kernel COMPLETE, topology == #37, coordinates == exp79a) is grandfathered under rule v2, with hidden L bounded by exp79a 9.27-9.45 h. The -m text starts with the exp75 token (family safetail_ci). The night slot this frees goes to exp83c only if the user says yes to Q3. Otherwise it goes to a dummy-PASSED CI arm on exp79a (exp89a MAX_UM 2.0 or exp89b TAU 0.7, dummy pushed at 50's read, PASS by 23:30Z), else to sched29's non-CI arm.' Read exp75 by the R25P-5 rule, not as an independent CI read. Put the pair choice to the user on the 29 Sep card: {V_pub, exp75} keeps CI in both finals, while {V_pub, #37} or {exp79a, exp70g} keeps one CI-free final. If the user objects before 50 turns terminal, keep amendment A as it stands.
